description: The emulation module contains commands that make the browser behave as it would in a different environment.

commands.name: setScrollbarTypeOverride
commands.description: Makes pages use classic or overlay scroll bars instead of the system setting, in the given top-level browsing contexts, in the given user contexts, or everywhere.

parameters.name: scrollbarType
parameters.description: "classic" or "overlay", or null to remove the override.

parameters.name: contexts
parameters.description: Top-level browsing contexts to override the scrollbar type for.

parameters.name: userContexts
parameters.description: User contexts to override the scrollbar type for.
